messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — saw a regression in the paged+fused Flash variant when running int8 tiled workloads. Tail latency up ~8% on long sequences. Posting profiler snippets.

ravi: Can you paste the flamegraph / perf counters? is this reproducible on dedicated nodes or only CI?

maya: Repro is consistent on my devbox (A100 80GB) and on a small dedicated pool. Snippet from nvprof run:

```
Kernel: flash_fused_paged_int8
duration_ms: 12.8 -> 13.9
L2_reads: 3.1e6
L2_writes: 2.2e5
L2_miss_rate: 0.18
warp_stalls_mem: +12%
```

Also see a 1.6x increase in kv-pagewalks for interleaved layout vs separate for certain stride patterns.

sam: Interesting. we changed the batching gating logic in the canary last week (allowing larger dynamic batches at seq>1024). Could be exposing a kernel selection edge where paged path picks fused kernel with suboptimal bank access.

anya: I ran microbench on layout alignment. When interleaved KV is 128-byte aligned we get expected perf. At 64-byte alignment, bank conflicts spike. Probably dtype packing + stride rounding hitting bank stride = 32 words -> conflict.

ravi: Do we have deterministic repro steps? sample payload / config?

maya: repro config:

```
model: gpt-like-16b
seq_len: 2048
dtype: int8
batching_policy: dynamic_gated
kv_layout: interleaved
kv_alignment: 64
kernel_selector: auto
```
Running with kv_alignment=128 reduces tail by ~6%.

sam: That suggests two levers: 1) kernel_selector should consider kv_alignment/dtype/stride as input, 2) batching gating should be conservative for paged-fused when interleaved+unaligned.

ci-bot: [automated test] perf-regression /eng-runtime/paged-fused-int8 — baseline: 12.7ms, head: 13.8ms (+8.7%). Test run: 2026-03-17T18:23:45Z. Artifacts: http://ci/internal/builds/4523

ravi: Can we add a quick heuristic: if kv_layout==interleaved && kv_alignment < 96 && dtype in (int8,int4) then prefer separate-paged kernel or force 128 align padding?

anya: Simple padding patch on encode side is low-risk, but increases memory. We should bench mem vs latency tradeoff.

maya: I can prototype a runtime patch that forces 128 alignment pad for interleaved when dtype=quantized and measure mem overhead on 16B model.

sam: Also add a selector feature flag to prefer non-fused kernel when dynamic batch > N and stride mismatch detected. We'll A/B canary it.

ravi: For the short term, add a CI check to catch kv_pagewalk counts regressing >10% for fused-paged kernels.

maya: Agree. I'll open PR with prototype + benchmark notes. Tagging @sam @anya for review. :thumbsup:

anya: Thanks — will run further stride scans (stride 1..64) across bank counts and post heatmap later.

ci-bot: Created issue INF-1289: "paged-fused int8 perf regression with interleaved KV alignment". Link: http://tracker/internal/INF-1289

maya: Closing loop here — next actions: maya -> proto pad patch, sam -> selector flag, ravi -> CI guard. Will sync in next standup.
